## Preparation scope

This article documents the changes implemented for the 1999 presidential election. It preserves the exact capitalisation of the labels used in that script. Replacement values and source findings have not been independently verified for this documentation.

## Unavailable postal registered-elector counts

Removed rows where `ColNames` is `No of Registered Electors`, `Electorate` is `Postal District Votes`, and `Votes` is missing. The correction section contains no candidate-count replacement or percentage recalculation.
